readiness.formula: Sources: rows per feed in the billing months the period touches, against the ingest manifest; InvoiceId share of those rows; format, FOCUS version and export mode are the feed's export settings on file; spend in the period on accounts flagged for CIP review. Tags: cost-weighted coverage per required tag, as on the Allocation page. Accounting: ledger dollars in the period by the basis of the rule that placed them (regulation, [POLICY] signed off, [POLICY] awaiting the controller's sign-off) and unmapped; capitalized dollars carrying a valid work order with a threshold date. Reconciliation: invoices in the period's billing months whose lines all tie within $1, or whose differences are labeled. Controls: C-01 to C-11 as on the Governance page. Each section scores 0 to 100; the overall score is their average.

discovery.title: Proposed Discovery: Data Readiness & Accounting Discovery, 4 weeks
weeks: Receive one closed month per cloud and profile each feed. Review the tag dictionary. Walk through current accounting with Regulated Accounting.
Draft the rule register against your chart of accounts, including five-digit subaccounts, and list the [POLICY] items for sign-off. Map the allocation factors to your service company's factor codes.
Load one closed month and the current open month per cloud into your Snowflake sandbox with the Native Snowflake Pipeline. Unbundle them, tie them to invoices and produce the scorecard.
Write the POC charter: scope, target test year, success criteria, security package (data path, roles, request for CIP classification) and the hand-over of the Client-Owned Codebase.
outputs: Rule register v0.9 mapped to your chart, with the [POLICY] items for sign-off
Tag standard with enforcement as code
One month unbundled to FERC accounts and tied to the invoices
